title: 3.01 / Colors
slide_intent: Assign a palette hierarchy so repeated color use creates a reliable visual reference.
strategic_value: Deep Blue as the primary color can maintain a stable Spectrum presence while Light Blue supplies contrast.
demonstration: Two large equal-sized swatches show Deep Blue and Light Blue with Pantone, CMYK, RGB and hex values; the note assigns Deep Blue priority.
practical_value: Separate swatch display size from usage guidance: equal rectangles do not prescribe equal use.

content_islands.name: Heading and priority rule
content_islands.spec: Place the title upper left and the signage color explanation across the upper middle.

content_islands.name: Brand blue swatches
content_islands.spec: Place two large horizontal neighbors beneath the Brand Blues label, with their names and reproduction values in each upper-left corner.

ingredient.name: Brand blues
ingredient.role: Provide a consistent blue reference with a primary and supporting hue.
ingredient.application: Use Deep Blue as the primary color. The page specifies Deep Blue #003057 and Light Blue #0099D8 with print equivalents.
ingredient.scope: Signage designs within the August 2017 retail guide; no numerical area ratio is prescribed.

reference_purposes.Expression: The two swatches establish Spectrum’s Deep Blue and Light Blue with their print and screen equivalents.
reference_purposes.Application: The signage note directs designers to make Deep Blue primary even though the two inspection swatches occupy equal areas.
